name: After § 6-Am 15
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
part_text: 6a. Takes note of the statement by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio of 9 March 2025 condemning the radical Islamist terrorists, including foreign jihadis, that murdered people in western Syria; offers its condolences to the victims and their families; demands that Syria’s interim authorities hold the perpetrators of these massacres against Syria’s minority communities accountable; is seriously concerned about the safety of Syria’s minorities in the light of the history of violations committed by Hay’at Tahrir al-Sham; emphasises that the treatment of the Christian, Druze and Alawite communities is the litmus test for the future relationship between the EU and the new Syrian regime;
